packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR.
Auto-merge dev dependencies on green CI, once a release has been public for three days: a compromised or broken publish is usually yanked within that window, and nobody reads an automerged PR.
The pinned TanStack router family — the three overrides, plus react-router-with-query, which binds to them — bump deliberately and together, not automatically.

The Convex adapter is pinned to an exact version, not a range: on a 0.x, ^0.12.2 and ~0.12.2 both read >=0.12.2 <0.13.0, so neither blocks 0.12.3+. 0.12.4 and 0.12.5 break typing (TS2322 on ConvexBetterAuthProvider), and 0.12.3 slows convex-test down. Unblock via get-convex/better-auth#420 — see KNOWN_ISSUES.md.

better-auth is boxed into >=1.6.22 <1.7.0. The floor is GHSA-qq9h-g4jm-xgf3 (high, account takeover on magic-link sign-in); the ceiling is the adapter peer (>=1.6.9 <1.7.0), which 1.7.x leaves. Patches inside 1.6.x stay ENABLED on purpose — that channel is what ships the next security fix, and closing it is how we got here. Only the minor/major jump is blocked.

pnpm: 10.x bumps keep the pin fresh and are welcome. The major is capped because pnpm 11 needs the config migration in KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Re-enable once the deployment target is confirmed to resolve pnpm 11 from packageManager.

nitro is a dated 3.0 beta pinned exactly. It produces the Vercel build output (KNOWN_ISSUES.md § Nitro picks its preset from the build host), and a newer beta can change it: bump by hand, with a preview deploy.

customManagers.description: The Convex MCP server in .mcp.json is pinned to the same convex version as package.json, so it moves with it.
